dedupe_keys.name: tecnalia weee waste from electrical and electronic equipment hyperspectral dataset

description: Artzai Picon and Arantza Bereciartua at TECNALIA publish calibrated hyperspectral images of electrical and electronic waste fragments. Zenodo supplies a ZIP free under CC BY 4.0. MATLAB arrays contain 76 spectral bands between approximately 415 and 1,008 nanometres, with RGB previews and pixel-level class masks. Metal categories include copper, brass, aluminium, stainless steel and white copper; lead has a reserved label but is absent. These observations can benchmark material-recognition components in automated waste-sorting simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this image collection. Coverage is laboratory scrap imaging, with original dates and sample counts not established in the description. White and dark references support calibration but do not establish transfer to moving conveyors or contaminated waste streams. Class imbalance and measurement uncertainty remain unchecked. No archive was downloaded, classifier trained or sorting recovery rate inferred.
